name: tiktok-agent
description: Twelve Claude skills for TikTok, built around a 30-day batch: research five creators' best posts, cluster the questions people ask, write 30 scripts with three-layer hooks (spoken, on-screen, first visual), film them in one session and post on a calendar. Also a caption linter that counts UTF-16 units, a cross-post checker for Shorts and Reels, a trend snapshot analyser, a TikTok Studio retention reader, comment reply drafts, a profile rubric and a humanizer. No scraping, nothing posted for you.
